name: the_hidden_component_is_not_in_the_step
why: Z-C21.11. The probe zc2111/probe_alleggeriti (30/9/2026, assembly T_hid: part A plus part B hidden with IComponent2.Visible = swComponentHidden) measured that the STEP of an assembly does not write a hidden component (1 solid in the file), while CreateMassProperty of the assembly weighs it (17000 mm3, B included). Up to library 0.146.0 export_step expected a solid for every part that is not suppressed, hidden ones included, and refused a right file for having fewer solids. The library now leaves hidden components out of the solids expected and names them; the mass and the box keep them and name them. The bench hides the block («hidden», read back with IsHidden(false) before the first step).
defect_caught: A right STEP refused because a hidden component was counted among the solids expected; a hidden component dropped from the mass or from the box; answers that do not say a hidden component was left out of the file.
_if_it_stays_green_on_the_old_library: It cannot: on 0.146.0 the solids expected are 2 and the file holds 1, and step 1 refuses for having fewer solids than the parts, while it asks for the file.
_the_numbers: Base 120 x 80 x 10 at the origin (x from -60 to 60, y from -5 to 5, z from -40 to 40), block 20 x 20 x 20 centred at x = 100 (x from 90 to 110, y and z from -10 to 10), both AISI 304 (8000 kg/m3). STEP: 1 solid, the base. Mass: 96000 + 8000 mm3, 0.768 + 0.064 = 0.832 kg. Box: 170 x 20 x 80. In the state the components sort by name, base first: the block is the second one.

expect.why: MEASURED on 30/9/2026: SOLIDWORKS does not write a hidden component into the STEP
THE LINE THAT TAKES THE DEFECT: the hidden block is left out of the solids expected. On 0.146.0 they are 2 and the step refuses
the component missing from the file is named
the block is the hidden one, as the preparation made it

expect.tolerance_why: rounded to four decimals: (96000 + 8000) mm3 x 8000 kg/m3 = 0.832 kg
expect.why: a hidden component weighs: the probe measured it in the assembly mass
the answer says a hidden component is in the mass

expect.tolerance_why: true extreme points, rounded to the hundredth
expect.why: the hidden block is in the box: x from -60 to 110, y from -10 to 10
and the box says it holds a hidden component
